cross_sectional_relative_strength.purpose: Align trailing company performance with the same-date peer-ordering return target.

features.return_5d_peer_rank: Average-tie percentile rank of adjusted_close(t)/adjusted_close(t-5)-1 among active same-date peers; (rank-1)/(peer_count-1).
features.momentum_20d_peer_rank: Average-tie percentile rank of adjusted_close(t)/adjusted_close(t-20)-1 among active same-date peers; (rank-1)/(peer_count-1).
features.momentum_60d_peer_rank: Average-tie percentile rank of adjusted_close(t)/adjusted_close(t-60)-1 among active same-date peers; (rank-1)/(peer_count-1).

cross_sectional_relative_strength.availability: After session t closes; uses only company observations at or before t and same-date peer values.

market_regime.purpose: Represent whether the wider market is calm, volatile, trending, or in drawdown.

features.spy_volatility_20d: Sample standard deviation of SPY daily returns over t-19 through t, multiplied by sqrt(252).
features.spy_drawdown_60d: Reconstructed SPY index at t divided by its maximum over t-59 through t, minus 1.
features.spy_price_to_sma50: Reconstructed SPY index at t divided by its mean over t-49 through t, minus 1.

market_regime.availability: After session t closes from SPY returns available through t; exact intraday source arrival is not claimed.

comparison.candidate: The same 14 features plus exactly one predeclared three-feature group.
comparison.rows: Identical task-specific ticker/date rows in both variants.
comparison.tuning: Training-side inner chronological validation only; outer folds scored once.

decision_rule.retain: Positive mean primary-metric difference and improvement in at least three of four folds; risk also requires non-worse High-risk recall and no increase in High-predicted-Low count.
decision_rule.reject: Non-positive mean difference and non-positive differences in at least three folds.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Every other outcome. Inconclusive groups are not promoted into the minimal candidate.

prohibitions: Do not inspect or tune on the reused 2024-2025 period.
Do not add indicators after seeing these two group results without a new versioned precommitment.
Do not overwrite the Phase 5 or Phase 6 continuation datasets or reports.
Do not add SEC fundamentals while the point-in-time readiness gate is blocked.
